name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Supreme Court continues to allow construction of Trump's White House ballroom
changes.summary: The Supreme Court divided 5-4 in allowing construction of the new White House ballroom to continue.

changes.title: Trump calls for federal tax incentives to benefit TV and movie industry
changes.summary: The proposal was quickly embraced by Democrats, particularly in California, who have otherwise been critical of the president.

changes.title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
changes.summary: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

changes.title: Justices give Trump major legal victory on ballroom project
changes.summary: A majority of Supreme Court justices ruled that construction can continue on President Trump’s White House ballroom, which also features a secure underground facility. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

changes.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. famine alert system that Trump shut down, then reopened
changes.summary: The highly regarded FEWS NET network stopped posting data on Afghanistan, Somalia and Yemen -- then says it will start posting again in September. What's the reason for this back-and-forth? (Image credit: Sally Hayden/SOPA Images/LightRocket).

changes.title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
changes.summary: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned. (Image credit: Michael Zamora).

changes.title: Trump's plan for economic D-day for Iran has one big hole: China
changes.summary: The Trump administration says it's asking countries to voluntarily cut off business with Iran to squeeze its economy further. But the most critical country — China — already says it won't cooperate.

changes.title: News Wrap: Supreme Court allows Trump ballroom construction to continue amid challenges
changes.summary: In our news wrap Monday, the Supreme Court is allowing construction to continue on President Trump's White House ballroom project as legal challenges play out, the Metropolitan Museum of Art is canceling a planned Met Gala exhibit on British designer John Galliano following a backlash and soccer superstar Lionel Messi.

changes.title: Tamara Keith and Amy Walter on Trump's midterm influence
changes.summary: NPR's Tamara Keith and Amy Walter of the Cook Political Report with Amy Walter join Amna Nawaz to discuss the latest political news, including President Trump's popularity going into the midterms as some Republicans start to distance themselves, the Michigan Senate race and Democrats still debating their November messa.

changes.title: Analyst breaks down challenges U.S. will face to unlock Venezuela's oil
changes.summary: President Trump announced an unprecedented agreement in which the Pentagon would become an investor in a private company granted exclusive oil development rights in Venezuela. Nick Schifrin discussed the deal with Francisco Monaldi, director of the Latin America Energy Program for the Baker Institute at Rice University.
